title: Israeli parliament elects new speaker backed by Netanyahu’s opponents
summary_full: Knesset’s appointment of Matan Kahana marks step towards reversing policies of outgoing governmentThe Israeli parliament elected a new speaker on Tuesday, a key step toward rolling back policies passed by the outgoing government led by the prime minister, Benjamin Netanyahu.The new speaker is Matan Kahana, an ally of Gadi Eisenkot, the party leader currently working to form the next government and replace Netanyahu.
